model: SeabedNet hazard-small v2 (34.8M; trained only where the 500 m disc is >=95% covered by NONNA-10 and the shallowest point is below the surface) over the full NONNA-100 archive (snapshot 2026-08-29)
criteria: mean map 21-150 m deep; P(shallowest point within 500 m < 10.5 m) >= 0.7; predicted shallowest point between 3 and 18 m; relief < 100 m; within 6 km of a published sounding; no published sounding shallower than 21 m within ~500 m; >= 2 km from the GSHHG full-resolution coastline; cluster of 5-300 cells spanning >= 2 rows and >= 2 columns; > 5 cells from the block edge; gravity-sane blocks; <= 2 per 0.25-degree box; ranked by peak probability then hazard mass
supersedes: shoal_list_2026-09-03.csv (v1, sha256 a0bc8c3d...) which stays sealed and will be scored as published; v1 was found to be dominated by near-shore and survey-line artefacts (see validation report)
rule: Each entry is a falsifiable claim: a survey line over the position either finds water shallower than ~21 m within 500 m or it does not. Scored per entry; results published either way.
